VoiceStudio

🎉 100,000 GitHub stars — thank you!

AI voice studio. On your device.

Clone, design, dub, dictate, transcribe and narrate in 646 languages.

Runs on your laptop, desktop, servers, phone, tablets and more

## What you can do

Voice cloning
Turn a clean reference recording into speech in a familiar voice.
Video dubbing
Translate and dub videos with speech timed to the original.

Voice design
Describe a voice in words and generate it.
Local models
Choose your engines and download only the models you need.
More screenshots

Workspace overview
Model packs
- **Dictate & transcribe** — A floating dictation widget and local transcription - **Narrate & batch** — Stories, audiobooks and queued jobs - **Connect & automate** — Local API, MCP, reusable recipes and watch folders Start with **VoiceStudio** (default, powered by k2-fsa/OmniVoice), or pick from dozens of other engines in the Model Manager. See the [features & engine catalog](docs/feature-catalog.md).

## Platforms Choose your system, then expand an installation method.
macOS · Homebrew · DMG · installer
**Stable · Apple Silicon**
macOS 13.3+ · Apple Silicon: local engines with Metal (MPS). ```sh brew tap debpalash/tap brew trust --cask debpalash/tap/voicestudio brew install --cask debpalash/tap/voicestudio ```
DMG Download the DMG for your Mac, open it and drag VoiceStudio into Applications. [Download](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest) · [Guide](docs/install/macos.md)
One-command installer ```sh curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh ```
Intel Mac · remote backend · Limited The app UI runs on Intel; connect it to a VoiceStudio backend on another computer. [Guide](docs/install/macos.md)
> [!NOTE] > On macOS, "VoiceStudio is damaged and can't be opened" means Gatekeeper blocked the app, not that the download is broken. See the [Gatekeeper fix](docs/install/macos.md#gatekeeper-quarantine).
Windows · PowerShell · EXE
**Stable · x64**
Windows 10/11 x64 · NVIDIA CUDA · AMD ROCm (opt-in) · CPU. ```powershell irm https://voicestudio.sh/install.ps1 | iex ``` [Download the Windows installer](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest) · [Guide](docs/install/windows.md) · [AMD ROCm](docs/install/windows-rocm.md)
Windows on ARM · experimental Native app UI; the x64 Python backend runs under emulation on the CPU. [Download](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest) · [Guide](docs/install/windows.md)
Linux · AUR · Snap · DEB · AppImage · Nix
**Stable · x64**
Linux x64 · NVIDIA CUDA · CPU · Vulkan for supported GGUF engines.
One-command installer ```sh curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh ```
Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS · AUR ```sh yay -S voicestudio-bin ``` Also available through `paru -S voicestudio-bin`. [Development sources](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/voicestudio-git) · `yay -S voicestudio-git`
Build from AUR and install with pacman ```sh sudo pacman -S --needed base-devel git git clone https://aur.archlinux.org/voicestudio-bin.git cd voicestudio-bin makepkg -s sudo pacman -U ./voicestudio-bin-*.pkg.tar.zst ```
Ubuntu / Debian / Linux Mint · DEB Download the `.deb` into the current folder, then install it: [Download](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest) ```sh sudo apt install ./VoiceStudio-*-linux-x64.deb ```
Snap · Ubuntu, Fedora, openSUSE and more With [snapd installed](https://snapcraft.io/docs/installing-snapd): ```sh sudo snap install voicestudio ``` To enable microphone access: ```sh sudo snap connect voicestudio:audio-record ```
Any Linux distribution · AppImage Download the AppImage into the current folder, then launch it: [Download](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest) ```sh chmod +x VoiceStudio-*-linux-x64.AppImage ./VoiceStudio-*-linux-x64.AppImage ```
Nix / NixOS · source environment Enter the repository’s FHS development environment, then run from source: ```sh git clone https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio.git cd VoiceStudio nix develop .#fhs bun run dev ``` [Guide](docs/install/nix.md)
[Guide](docs/install/linux.md)
Docker · GHCR · Docker Hub
Stable images · CPU · NVIDIA CUDA · AMD ROCm. **Run locally on the CPU (Bash)** ```sh export OMNIVOICE_API_KEY="$(openssl rand -hex 32)" docker run -d --name omnivoice \ -p 127.0.0.1:3900:3900 \ -e OMNIVOICE_API_KEY \ -e OMNIVOICE_DATA_DIR=/app/omnivoice_data \ -v omnivoice-data:/app/omnivoice_data \ ghcr.io/debpalash/voicestudio:stable printf 'API key: %s\n' "$OMNIVOICE_API_KEY" ``` Open http://localhost:3900 and use the API key printed below. [NVIDIA, AMD ROCm and Compose instructions](docs/install/docker.md) [Docker Hub mirror](https://hub.docker.com/r/palashdeb/omnivoice-studio): `palashdeb/omnivoice-studio:stable`
Android · APK · Obtainium · F-Droid repository
Android 10+ · Preview · On-device, offline after model download. [Download APK](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest) · [Guide](docs/mobile.md#install)
F-Droid · VoiceStudio repository Add this repository in an F-Droid-compatible client; verify the fingerprint in the guide. ```text https://debpalash.github.io/VoiceStudio/fdroid/repo ``` [Guide](store/fdroid/README.md)
Obtainium · GitHub releases Add this source in Obtainium, or import the provided configuration. ```text https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio ``` [Import configuration](https://debpalash.github.io/VoiceStudio/obtainium.json)
Install over USB with adb ```sh adb install -r VoiceStudio-*-android.apk ```
iPhone / iPad · IPA · sideloading
iOS / iPadOS 17+ · Preview · On-device, offline after model download. Download the IPA and follow the signing and sideloading instructions. [Download](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest) · [Guide](docs/mobile.md#install)
Desktop and phone installers are on the [latest release](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest); Docker images come from GHCR. No GPU? The app is fully usable on the CPU, just slower. Native GGUF engines can also use Vulkan on AMD, Intel and NVIDIA GPUs; OmniVoice GGUF picks its GPU and model size automatically on Windows and Linux ([OmniVoice](docs/engines/omnivoice-gguf.md#vulkan-acceleration), [CosyVoice](docs/engines/cosyvoice-gguf.md)). Speed by engine and hardware: [performance](docs/performance.md). ## Get started Install using the options above. Then open **Voice cloning**, pick a voice or add a clean reference recording, type your text and generate. The app asks before it downloads any model.
More install options: a specific version, current main, uninstall, from source, with a coding agent ```sh curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --version X.Y.Z # a specific release curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --main # build current main curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --uninstall # remove the app, keep your data ``` If `voicestudio.sh` is unreachable, run the script straight from the repository: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/main/scripts/install.sh | sh`. Prerequisites and behavior: [installer guide](docs/install/script.md). **From source** ```bash git clone https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio.git cd VoiceStudio bun run dev ``` `bun run dev` installs the JavaScript dependencies and, when using a supported local backend, the Python dependencies before launching Electron. Run `bun run setup:api` directly when you only need to rebuild the Python environment. See [Electron setup](electron/README.md). **With a coding agent** (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, …), paste: ```text Install the VoiceStudio app on this device and verify it works, following https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/blob/main/docs/install/agent.md ``` Upgrading from 0.5.3 or older (the Tauri app)? [Install the new app separately](docs/electron-migration.md).
